info.title: live-platform API
info.description: Errors are always `{code, message, traceId}` (`ErrorBody`). Every POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE must send an allowed `Origin` and `X-Requested-With: live-platform`, or it is rejected with 403 `CSRF_REJECTED`. A body over 64 KiB is rejected with 413 `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, and a request that takes over 10 seconds with 503 `REQUEST_TIMEOUT`. Ids are decimal strings.

get.summary: Follow a broadcast's comments live (Server-Sent Events)
get.description:
A `text/event-stream` with these events:

- `comments`: `data` is a JSON array of `Comment`, every change (post, edit, delete) within about 200 ms, oldest first; `id` is the newest `revision` in it. Upsert by `id`, keeping the higher `revision`; a deleted comment arrives with `body: null`.
- `policy`: `data` is a `ChatPolicy`; sent when the stream opens, after catching up what it missed, and on every change.
- `reset`: too much was missed to replay; reload the list. `data` is `{"revision": string}`, also the event's `id`.

Not subject to the 10 second request limit. A reconnecting `EventSource` sends `Last-Event-ID` and receives what it missed.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The last `id` received; sent by `EventSource` on reconnect. `0` replays from the first comment

parameters.name: after
parameters.description:
Receive every change after this revision first: the `revision` of
the comment list. `Last-Event-ID` takes precedence.

id.description: Snowflake id as a decimal string.

description.description: At most 2000 characters; may be empty.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

slowModeSeconds.description:
Seconds a viewer waits between comments to this broadcast, 0 to 300;
0 is off. The broadcaster is never slowed down.

body.description: `null` once deleted. Plain text: escape it when rendering.

revision.description:
Position of this comment's latest change in the broadcast's change
feed, as a decimal string. Of two copies of one comment, keep the one
with the higher revision.

body.description: Trimmed, then 1 to 500 characters on one line.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

revision.description:
The newest revision when the page was read, `"0"` before the first
comment. Open the event stream with `?after=<revision>` to receive
every change since.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

code.description: Stable SCREAMING_SNAKE identifier to match on, such as `VERSION_CONFLICT`.

message.description: Human-readable; do not match on it.

traceId.description: Also in the `x-trace-id` header; quote it when reporting a problem.

kid.description: RFC 7638 thumbprint; matches the `kid` header of every token.

expiresIn.description:
Seconds the token may wait before its one use. The publish session it
opens lasts until the publisher leaves or the broadcast ends.

token.description:
Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on the WHIP request. Allows
publishing to this broadcast only, once.

whipUrl.description: Same-origin WHIP endpoint to POST the SDP offer to.

Recording.description:
One recorded segment of a broadcast. A broadcast may have several: one
per publisher connection, and one per 30 minutes of a long one.

nextBefore.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

expiresAt.description:
When `url` stops working: five minutes from now, whatever the
recording's length.

url.description:
An MP4 to play in a `<video>` element. It supports range requests,
so seeking works. Ask again for a new one when playback fails.

id.description: Snowflake id as a decimal string.
